fields.summary_ko.0: Amazon (AMZN)'s current P/E ratio of 21.4x is below the 3-year average of 34.6x; under an annual 13% revenue growth scenario, the stock is projected to rise approximately 33.4% within 3 years.
fields.summary_ko.1: AWS recorded 39.3% growth in Q3 2026, nearly the highest growth rate in 5 years, and the company expects approximately $220B capital expenditure in 2026.
